context_requirements: Active nucleotide salvage and de novo purine/pyrimidine synthesis pathways
Proliferating cells with high demand for nucleotide precursors
Intact p53 pathway for full transcriptional response to nucleotide stress
Expression of the targeted dehydrogenases (HPRT1, IMPDH1, PPAT)
falsifiers: No change in expression of nucleotide biosynthesis genes (e.g., IMPDH1, PPAT, HPRT1) at 6 or 24 h
Lack of antiproliferative or apoptotic signature at 24 h in all nine cell lines
Predominant upregulation of cell cycle genes rather than downregulation
No evidence of UPR or stress response activation at 24 h

evidence.supports: LDH inhibition blocks glycolysis and ATP production, leading to growth inhibition and stress responses in breast cancer cells
LDHA inhibition suppresses tumor growth and induces mitochondria-mediated apoptosis via ROS
DHODH inhibition induces apoptosis and G1 cell cycle arrest in multiple myeloma cells
IMPDH inhibition by 6-azauracil causes sensitivity in yeast mutants, implicating nucleotide depletion and transcriptional stress
IMPDH inhibition depletes GTP, induces caspase-dependent apoptosis and G1-S arrest in multiple myeloma cells
